violated_contract: A tool advertised to a surface must execute through an executor that can run on that surface without another surface's invocation envelope. When desktop chat advertised web_search while GeneratedToolExecutors still bound it to realtimeHub, authorized main_chat commands reached RealtimeHub.executeAuthorizedRealtimeTool with no Push-to-Talk authorizedRealtimeInvocations entry and failed with unknown_realtime_invocation before the public-web lane ran. Advertising plus a dead ChatToolExecutor branch is not a working capability.
canonical_prevention: Dual-surface swift tools resolve their physical executor from surfaceKind as well as tool name. Typed-chat web_search must parse to chatToolExecutor; realtime_voice keeps realtimeHub for acknowledgements, historical multi-pass, and turn evidence. Pin the contract with a behavioral AuthorizedToolExecution.parse test for both surfaces and a ChatToolExecutor web_search paywall/success path that never emits unknown_realtime_invocation.
